units.rawText: My first encounter with the Professor... It was under a full moon's glow. I guided the lost lambs to the Professor's side that night...
units.displayText: My first encounter with the Professor... It was under a full moon's glow. I guided the lost lambs to the Professor's side that night...

spans.text: My first encounter with the Professor... It was under a full moon's glow. I guided the lost lambs to the Professor's side that night...

units.rawText: Oh~ Now I remember. The expressions on Dushevnaya and Max's faces were quite something back then.
units.displayText: Oh~ Now I remember. The expressions on Dushevnaya and Max's faces were quite something back then.

spans.text: Oh~ Now I remember. The expressions on Dushevnaya and Max's faces were quite something back then.

units.rawText: It was also on that night, I was able to meet Centaureissi again...
units.displayText: It was also on that night, I was able to meet Centaureissi again...

spans.text: It was also on that night, I was able to meet Centaureissi again...

units.rawText: Looking back, we were kind of rude that night, weren't we? Just putting the Professor aside like that. Sorry!
units.displayText: Looking back, we were kind of rude that night, weren't we? Just putting the Professor aside like that. Sorry!

spans.text: Looking back, we were kind of rude that night, weren't we? Just putting the Professor aside like that. Sorry!

units.rawText: It's nothing. I understand how joyful your reunion must have been. Alright, I should get going...
units.displayText: It's nothing. I understand how joyful your reunion must have been. Alright, I should get going...

spans.text: It's nothing. I understand how joyful your reunion must have been. Alright, I should get going...

units.rawText: Professor... The breath of the dead lingers in Magrasea. Death may be inevitable, but in my heart, I wish...
units.displayText: Professor... The breath of the dead lingers in Magrasea. Death may be inevitable, but in my heart, I wish...

spans.text: Professor... The breath of the dead lingers in Magrasea. Death may be inevitable, but in my heart, I wish...

units.rawText: No, I believe our journey doesn't end here. No matter what difficulty lays ahead, however long the night... the dawn will break.
units.displayText: No, I believe our journey doesn't end here. No matter what difficulty lays ahead, however long the night... the dawn will break.

spans.text: No, I believe our journey doesn't end here. No matter what difficulty lays ahead, however long the night... the dawn will break.

units.rawText: Right, right! Let there not be any more guests for me to hold! Someone come here and nail me closed!
units.displayText: Right, right! Let there not be any more guests for me to hold! Someone come here and nail me closed!

spans.text: Right, right! Let there not be any more guests for me to hold! Someone come here and nail me closed!

units.rawText: Wait a moment, I think that'd kinda hurt so please don't... but my hope remains the same!
units.displayText: Wait a moment, I think that'd kinda hurt so please don't... but my hope remains the same!

spans.text: Wait a moment, I think that'd kinda hurt so please don't... but my hope remains the same!

units.rawText: Thank you all. I also want to believe... no, I guarantee that in the days ahead in the Cloud, I'll make certain you never need to do your job ever again.

units.rawText: Yes... I believe in Professor for my eternity.
